notes.title: New version is now live!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42599890/4cb6c436573af416c801b2e64c50c4b14d9a02e5.png

Hi!

Thank you again for waiting for so long.
The latest update is finally here and it's adding plenty of new sounds and visuals.

Most importantly, there's a new UI allowing for browsing the generative artworks. Each combination of music and 3D visuals is unique, and defined by a single ID visible in the bottom-right corner. 
It's like browsing from an almost infinite selection of music loops with their own audio visualizers.

And here's a more detailed list of the main changes:

 Now featuring 5 full audio-visual scenes
 New interface for browsing the generative variations
 Visuals and sounds now are connected together
 Introducing IDs for saving and sharing specific combinations
 Updated audio reactive mode - now supporting system audio and microphone inputs
 Auto-saving state of each scene
 Simplified visual settings
 And many more performance and usability fixes


Feel free to share any feedback over here or via social media.
Thanks!

notes.title: New version in the works!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42599890/1fa5fa89eeb62df22eb7b3e7b687d3e2c07f5316.png

Sorry for the long wait! 

And thank you for such an encouraging response to the first version of the app. 

That response and feedback has been a great motivating factor to continue developing this app into a fully featured experience. One of the first decisions following that was to change the rendering pipeline to optimize for a wider range of devices, to allow it to run with way less overhead, especially on laptops, hopefully allowing it to also work as a screensaver without making it sound like your machine is going to explode.

Long story short, rebuilding it took waaaaaaay more time than expected, but the new app is now stable, and has way more features, including 5 different scenes, saving/picking IDs, brand new soundtrack, and many more.

Unfortunately there's no fixed release date yet, but there's only a few things left to make this new version fully feature complete, and it seems that it might be a better idea to take care of all the bugs and not rush it out.

And as always, feel free to share any fixes or feature requests you'd like to see in the future updates.

Thank you for your time! 🐜
